name: Angustinaripterus
sum: Middle Jurassic rhamphorhynchine from Sichuan, China, with a long, flat skull and a low crest.
wsnote: Estimated by Wellnhofer (1991) from skull length.
holotype: ZDM T8001 — Xiashaximiao (Lower Shaximiao) Formation, Dashanpu, Zigong, Sichuan.
material: Single skull with lower jaws; left side badly damaged.
biology: Long, curved, interlocking front teeth formed a ‘fish grab’, probably used to snatch fish from the water surface.
author: He et al. 1983

species.name: Angustinaripterus longicephalus
species.author: He et al. 1983
species.ref: X. He, D. Yan, and C. Su. 1983. A new pterosaur from the Middle Jurassic of Dashanpu, Zigong, Sichuan. Journal of the Chengdu College of Geology 1:27-33
